note: Every numeric constant of the process engine, with its unit and source. Python and TypeScript engines both read this file; scripts/check_units.py rejects undeclared literals in engine modules and entries without unit or source.

grid.top_um.source: Design: upper bound of the coarsest class, above the coarsest crusher feed in the catalog.

grid.n_classes.source: Design: the pan boundary falls at 3.24 um.

bond.reference_feed_um.source: Design: reference reduction at which Rittinger and Kick are calibrated to Bond.

bond.reference_product_um.source: Design: reference reduction at which Rittinger and Kick are calibrated to Bond.

mill.mixer_fractions.source: Austin, Klimpel and Luckie (1984): one large and two equal small perfect mixers; the fractions are this product's declared values.

water.density_t_m3.source: Process water at plant temperature, rounded.

plitt.d50_coefficient.source: Plitt (1976) CIM Bull. 69(776):114-123, as documented in SysCAD Hydrocyclone.

plitt.pressure_window_kpa.source: Flag window, authored: the Moly-Cop base case runs at 53 kPa; values outside the window are reported, not rejected.

flotation.sb_factor.source: Sb = 6 Jg/D32 (Gorain et al. 1997) with Jg in cm/s and D32 in mm.

savassi.constant.source: Savassi et al. (1998) Miner. Eng. 11(3):243-256, as typeset in Hoang et al. (2019) eq. 3.

batch.times_min.source: Design: laboratory batch-flotation sampling schedule for the virtual test.

numerics.recycle_rel_tolerance.source: Numerics: largest per-class relative change between recycle passes at convergence, so trace minerals close as tightly as the bulk (PE-02).

numerics.composite_scale_tolerance.source: Numerics: largest per-class change of the host-limited composite scale at convergence in the grinding circuit.

numerics.composite_scale_max_iterations.source: Numerics: iteration cap of the host-limited composite fixed point.

numerics.laguerre_nodes.source: Numerics: Gauss-Laguerre order for the residence-time projection.

grinding.energy_bracket_kwh_t.unit: kWh per t of mill feed per pass

flotation.composite_surface_exponent.source: Declared: the exposed surface of a composite grain scales with the two-thirds power of its valuable content.

numerics.negative_mass_tolerance_per_tph.source: Numerics: a class mass below minus this tolerance raises a negative-mass flag.

numerics.cut_search_step_ratio.source: Numerics: geometric step of the cut-size bracket search.

numerics.energy_guess_floor_kwh_t.source: Numerics: floor of the Bond-based starting guess for the energy search.

kinetics.beta_bounds.source: Declared: range of the exponent that keeps the model identifiable on a nine-point batch curve; above 1 the curve has a delayed onset (compressed), below 1 it reflects a spread of rates (stretched); dossier section 3.6, Vinnett and Waters (2025), doi:10.1016/j.mineng.2025.109246.

kinetics.dense_points.source: Design: samples of each fitted curve from 0 to the last batch time (0.25 min spacing over 16 min), for plotting from the record.

numerics.lm_damping_factor.source: Numerics: damping decrease on an accepted step and increase on a rejected one.

numerics.lm_damping_bounds.source: Numerics: damping limits; reaching the upper one means no step lowers the residual in double precision.

numerics.lm_diagonal_floor.source: Numerics: floor on the diagonal of the normal matrix used for Marquardt scaling.
